name: Gardien des laisses
description: A broad tall middle-aged adult, ochre-grey speckled skin, broad domed skull with heavy eye ridges, four fleshy external mandibles, short dense biological tendrils with two copper rings. Black-brown leather sleeveless working jerkin over dark woven trousers, asymmetric dark steel shoulder guard, a VERY thick quilted bite-protection sleeve on the left forearm. Holds a neatly coiled heavy leather leash in the right hand and rests the protected arm at the hip. Metal collar buckles, feeding sachets and clipped signal whistle on belt. Calm confident stance.
